segments.evidence: Core Business Segments We operate in the following three segments as of December 31, 2025 : Electronic Funds Transfer ("EFT") Segment Our Electronic Funds Transfer ("EFT") segment meets the needs of financial institutions and consumers through Euronet-owned and outsourced Automated Teller Machines ("ATMs") and Point-of-Sale ("POS") terminals combined with value added and transaction processing services.
